description: Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua) is an open data portal listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Ministry of Digital Transformation of Ukraine. Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua) publishes open datasets. Coverage: Ukraine. This harvest read all datasets of the portal through its CKAN API; 1,135 of them are about infrastructure or natural hazards and became 631 records. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.

discovery_routes.query: CKAN package_search read of all datasets
